info.name: Baserow API spec Admin Trash API

items.docs: Responds with the workspaces and applications available for the requesting user to inspect the trash contents of.
Restores the specified trashed item back into baserow.

params.name: application_id
params.description: Optionally filters down the trash to only items for this application in the workspace.

params.name: page
params.description: Selects which page of trash contents should be returned.

params.name: workspace_id
params.description: Returns the trash for the workspace with this id.

items.docs: Responds with trash contents for a workspace optionally filtered to a specific application.

params.name: application_id
params.description: Optionally filters down the trash to delete to only items for this application in the workspace.

params.name: workspace_id
params.description: The workspace whose trash contents to empty, including the workspace itself if it is also trashed.

items.docs: Empties the specified workspace and/or application of trash, including the workspace and application themselves if they are trashed also.
